Ad spend

Clicks that aren’t ready leave

Your ads already pay for attention. A woman who isn’t ready to book a diagnostic call today has nothing to say yes to, so most of what you paid to reach her leaves with her.

No front end

Every ad dollar waits on a closed call

With no paid first step, ad spend is only recovered when a call turns into a client. A small paid offer pays part of the ad bill upfront, which is what lets you spend more.

No filter

A free call is easy to book and easy to skip

When the only step is a free call, curious and ready look the same until you’re on Zoom together. Your time goes to both.

You already have the audience and the ads. What’s missing is the step in between that turns clicks into buyers, and buyers into the right calls.

Script 1 · “Why they show up together”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do bloating, breakouts and fatigue so often show up in the same conversation?”

Body

“Most women we talk to have been treating them as three separate problems: a cream for the skin, a coffee for the energy, one less food for the bloating. In functional practice we start from a different place. We ask what might be sitting underneath all three, and the gut is usually where we look first.”

CTA

“We walk through exactly how we think about it in our live Root Cause Masterclass. It’s 60 minutes, $17, replay included. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: Julia and Lena side by side, talking to camera, bright neutral backdrop. On-screen text: “three symptoms, one question”. Caption ends with “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “Before you cut another food”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s what we look at before anyone cuts another food.”

Body

“Elimination diets are usually the first thing people try, and they can turn into a long list of foods to fear. Before any of that, we look at the foundations: digestion, sleep, stress and what a day of eating really looks like. Then, if it makes sense, functional lab testing to get information instead of guessing.”

CTA

“We teach those root-cause questions live in our masterclass. $17, replay included. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: one of you talking to camera, the other cuts in with a text card listing “digestion, sleep, stress, food”.

Script 3 · “What a lab test actually looks at”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“People ask us all the time what functional lab testing actually shows.”

Body

“It’s not magic, and it isn’t a diagnosis. It’s information: a closer look at things a standard panel often doesn’t cover. Used well, it helps a practitioner build a plan around the person, not around a trend. Used badly, it’s just another expensive guess.”

CTA

“In The Root Cause Masterclass we explain what we test, when, and why. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera holding a sample lab kit box (no results shown), split-screen text “information, not a diagnosis”.
